title: 200 Watchers swear an oath on Mount Hermon

tellings.quote: they did this thing, they bound themselves on the summit of Mount Hermon. According to the Book of Enoch, they descended on the summit of Mount Hermon

plain: Two hundred fallen angels called the Watchers are said to have come down onto the top of Mount Hermon and bound themselves together there with an oath. A researcher named Tim Alberino tells this from the Book of Enoch, an ancient religious text that is not in most Bibles, which he reads in R. H. Charles's English translation alongside Genesis 6. In his words, "they bound themselves on the summit of Mount Hermon," and he tells it as the start of a story about beings who came down from above and mixed with humans.
